Benefits Of Working With Mobilunity

Large Pool of Experienced RPA Developers

Due to our global reach, we can find and hire top RPA developers in Eastern Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Latin America, and other nearshore / offshore destinations. You can access a vast pool of tech talent and onboard rare-skilled engineers with us.

Up to 2X Lower Prices

Accessing global talents, you can acquire skilled developers in regions with lower living costs and make substantial savings. Due to our thorough assessment of our candidates’ technical skills, competitive prices never mean compromising the quality of work.

Thorough Tech Vetting

With 150+ successful projects under the belt, Mobilunity has developed a proven approach to assessing applicants’ hard skills. We ensure the developers you contract with us will have expertise with RPA tools and technologies required for the project.

50% Faster Recruiting than In-House

For 10+ years in the market, Mobilunity has gained deep expertise in tech recruiting. Our streamlined searching and hiring approaches allow us to get your automation team within 3-6 weeks, which is up to 2X faster than in-house employment.

100% Transparency in Cooperation

We establish open and proactive communication that streamlines candidate selection and boosts effective collaboration with your RPA experts. With regular 1:1 meetings and timely communication, Mobilunity keeps you timely updated and involved.

Ongoing Retention

The retention of your developers starts with their onboarding and continues throughout our collaboration. Mobilunity’s engineers spend 3 years with the client on average. One of our projects has boasted a 100% retention rate for the past 7 years!

Extend or Build Your RPA Development Team with Mobilunity!

Build a new or augment your existing team with Mobilunity’s skilled RPA specialists to embrace automation initiatives of any scope. Contract our developers to automate processes and boost your employee and customer satisfaction.

FAQs on Contracting RPA Developers

How much does it cost to hire an RPA developer?

The hiring cost will depend on a few factors: the seniority of your coders, our cooperation format, and the country where you’re looking to hire expert RPA developers. Schedule a free consultation to learn the estimated cost of your RPA project. 

What do automation specialists do?

These programmers analyze your objectives and processes, decide which tasks to robotize, and select relevant automation tools. Then, they design, develop, test, and implement RPA bots into your existing infrastructure, helping you create advanced Robotic Process Automation solutions.

What technical skills should a top RPA engineer have?

They should know several programming languages like C/C++, Java, JavaScript, Ruby, or Python and have tech proficiency in RPA tools like UiPath, Blue Prism, and Automation Anywhere. However, strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic planning are non-tech yet imperative skills for this role.

What level of automation expertise do your developers possess?

Mobilunity’s certified RPA developers specialize in creating industry-specific bots. They’re versed in a variety of RPA tools and approaches, including IA, and leverage their systematic approach to solve problems, strategic vision, and Business Process Automation skills. 

Can you help with technical interviews?

Of course. Mobilunity offers on demand technical interview service to help you test your automation developers’ hard skills. Our experts will assess candidates’ competencies and provide you with professional recommendations in a report. 

How can hiring an automation developer benefit my business?

Automation specialists analyze your business processes and identify which tasks can be automated. They create RPA solutions that allow companies to optimize resources, cut costs, and get more accurate analytics for decision-making. With these professionals, you can also eliminate errors in repetitive tasks and improve team communication.

How can I hire an RPA developer with Mobilunity?

We’ll discuss your project requirements, select an optimized cooperation format, and source vetted candidates. You’ll join their interviews and select future team members. We contract, onboard, and assist them throughout our collaboration while you get full operational control over your RPA development team. The entire process takes around 6 weeks. 

Can your developers integrate automation solutions with my existing systems?

Absolutely. The automation development experts you hire with Mobilunity don’t just create and deploy software robotics. They synchronize software robotics with your company’s other tools, databases, workflows, and business processes.

How do your specialists ensure the security and compliance of automation solutions?

Mobilunity’s hired developers use the approaches of leading RPA development companies to mitigate the security risks of your solutions. These include encrypted password management, authentication protocols, assigning unique credentials to bots, and strict access controls. Additionally, they proactively monitor bots, regularly audit scripts, and maintain log integrity. 

What other services do your automation professionals offer?

They can create reliable RPA systems for large enterprises and build small automation projects for startups. They also run autonomous agents on Docker containers to allow parallel execution of multiple processes and integrate bots with ERP, CRM, and CMS systems for seamless automation of routine tasks.
